read_command: herdr --session pipeline_s04 agent read s04_cx_short --source recent --lines 400
note_sampling: states polled every 0.5s; transitions shorter than the interval can be missed. This is a sample, not a complete event history.
category: negative case — settled 'done' with no answer; delivery unconfirmed
expected_verdict_basis: No anchored verdict line, and no answer of any kind, in the capture.
finding: herdr agent prompt --wait returned exit 0 with agent_status 'done' after 1.1 s, and the 0.5 s poller recorded idle -> working -> done, while the capture contains no turn output and the input box shows its placeholder.
why_it_matters: Counter-example to trusting lifecycle state or exit code as proof that a specific prompt completed. Only output that answers the prompt establishes that.
units_note: read_chars / read_later_chars are Unicode character counts (Python len of the decoded text); read_bytes / read_later_bytes are the UTF-8 file sizes. An earlier revision mislabelled the character counts as bytes.
read_timing_note: The harness sleeps ~2 s after agent prompt returns (to finish polling) before the first read, then ~5 s more before the second. No capture was taken immediately at settle, so nothing here establishes whether an immediate read is complete.
what_the_evidence_shows: A successful exit code and a settled 'done' state coexisted with a capture containing no answer. That is sufficient to show the exit code and lifecycle state did not establish that this prompt completed.
what_the_evidence_does_NOT_show: Why. Delivery is UNCONFIRMED: the text may never have arrived, or may have arrived and been discarded. The observed working -> done transitions are unexplained by a 'never delivered' account and were not traced to a cause.
